name: Hana Jalloul Muro - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on relations between the EU and Saudi Arabia
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its view on relations between the EU and Saudi Arabia. It is not a law. It asks the EU to negotiate a formal partnership agreement with Saudi Arabia covering trade, energy, security and human rights. It also calls for visa-free travel for Saudi citizens, closer cooperation on regional conflicts, and stronger pressure on Saudi Arabia over executions, detentions and workers' rights.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only recommends; talks on a partnership agreement come next.
- **Who it affects:** Saudi citizens, workers there, EU companies and travellers.
- **What happens next:** The EU Commission and countries decide whether to open formal negotiations.
